process.summary: The repository shows build metadata, placeholder tests and application configuration, but does not show CI/CD, deployment or observability setup in this demo.

observations.description: Important scenario names exist, but the demo methods are empty.
No CI/CD workflow file is present in the demo repository analysis scope.
Maven coordinates and version are present, but no release automation is visible.
No logging, metrics or tracing configuration is visible in the compact demo repository.
KYC provider URL and risk threshold are configured, but the service still hard-codes the threshold.
Maven project metadata exists; no dedicated local setup guide is present in the compact demo.

open_questions: Which authentication mechanism protects the REST endpoints?
Which downstream consumers subscribe to customer.onboarding.started?

quality.summary: The code is small and readable, but some production-readiness concerns are visible: hard-coded threshold, placeholder tests and direct RestTemplate construction.

strengths.title: Clear layering
strengths.description: Controller, service, repository, integration client and publisher responsibilities are separated.

risks.title: Hard-coded decision threshold
risks.description: The business threshold is coded directly in the service.
risks.recommendation: Inject the configured risk.threshold value into the service.

risks.title: KYC client creates RestTemplate directly
risks.description: Direct construction makes timeout/retry/testing configuration harder.
risks.recommendation: Inject an HTTP client or RestTemplate bean with configured timeouts.

security.title: No visible REST authentication enforcement
security.description: The REST controller exposes onboarding and status endpoints, while the compact build file does not show a Spring Security dependency or security configuration in the analyzed scope.
security.recommendation: Confirm intended access model; if these endpoints are not public, add authentication/authorization configuration and tests.

testability.title: Business scenarios are named
testability.description: Test methods identify the main cases to cover.

testability.title: Tests need assertions
testability.description: The demo methods do not contain test bodies.

findings.title: Risk threshold is hard-coded
findings.description: The code uses riskScore > 70 directly while configuration also contains risk.threshold: 70.
findings.recommendation: Read the threshold from configuration and add tests for boundary values 70 and 71.

findings.title: Scenario tests are placeholders
findings.description: The test class names important scenarios but lacks executable assertions.
findings.recommendation: Implement duplicate, high-risk and low-risk tests with mocked repository/KYC/publisher dependencies.

findings.title: Authentication requirements are not visible
findings.description: The analyzed repository exposes customer onboarding REST endpoints, but no authentication or authorization configuration is visible in the compact source scope.
findings.recommendation: Document whether the API is intentionally public; otherwise add auth configuration and endpoint-level security tests.
